seo.titulo: Eventarium — organize and discover events without commissions
seo.descripcion: Open platform for organizing events: registrations, QR tickets, speakers, sponsors, and accounting, with your brand and no platform commission.

hero.titulo: Organize events with **your brand.** **No commissions.** No lock-ins.
hero.subtitulo: Eventarium brings together in one place what you currently split between five tools: registrations, tickets, schedule, speakers, sponsors, and accounting. **Open source**, installable anywhere you want.

enDirecto.vacio: There are no live events right now.

quienesSomos.titulo: A tool made by **people who organize events**
quienesSomos.parrafo1: Anyone organizing an event today ends up using Luma or Eventbrite for registrations, Sessionize or Pretalx for speakers, a spreadsheet for accounting and sponsorships, and an improvised page for the rest. **Five tools**, five exports, five places where things get out of sync.
quienesSomos.parrafo2: The open-source alternatives we found were abandoned, hid important features behind a **paywall**, or forced you to show **their brand** on your event.
quienesSomos.parrafo3: Eventarium was born to bring all that together in a single system: **open**, installable on your own server, and **with your brand**. No ticket commission and no mandatory attribution: **the event is yours**.

funcionalidades.intro: Every block you see here **exists and works today**. No roadmaps.

inscripciones.texto: Your attendees sign up with an email, **without creating an account**. Email verification, on-demand approval when you want to filter, and an **automatic waitlist** when capacity is reached.
inscripciones.captura: Event registration dashboard: funnel from form to ticket, three confirmed requests, and status filters.

entradas.texto: Each ticket carries a **signed and non-transferable** code. At the door, the scanning app validates in a second and prevents the same ticket from being used twice.
entradas.captura: Door check-in screen with verified ticket counter, recent scans, and manual search.

marca.texto: Logo, colors, page template, and social media per organization. The audience sees **your event**; Eventarium doesn't appear anywhere.
marca.captura: Organization visual identity: logo, social media, and page template selection.

politicas.texto: Each organization writes **its own terms**, refunds, and privacy policies, and can adapt them to **each event**. Those who register accept them, and the exact version is recorded.
politicas.captura: Organization policies: event terms, refund and privacy policies, with editor and preview.

patrocinadores.texto: Gold, silver, bronze, or **whatever tiers you define**. Each sponsor has their profile, their logo on the site, and their place in the schedule.
patrocinadores.captura: Event sponsors by tier (gold, silver, collaborator) with their logo, contribution, and sign-up form.

contabilidad.texto: Budget, income, expenses, and in-kind contributions in the same dashboard. Upload a photo of a receipt and **AI extracts** the vendor, date, base, VAT, and total so you only have to confirm them.
contabilidad.captura: Event ledger: budget vs. actual, income committed by sponsorship, and expense entry by receipt.

agenda.texto: Sessions, rooms, and speakers, but also coffee breaks, meals, and event services as **first-class data**, not as footnotes.
agenda.captura: Event schedule by days: each session with its title, time, and room, along with the speakers participating in the event.

ponentes.texto: Public profile, email invitations, and **track record across editions**. Someone who spoke in the last edition appears in the next one without re-entering their data.
ponentes.captura: Speaker profiles with their assigned session, profile status, and editions they have participated in.

pagos.texto: Connect your own Stripe account and charge for tickets directly. Eventarium **takes no percentage**: 0% is in the code, not just in the brochure.
pagos.captura: Ticket types for a paid event (General €45, VIP €99) with capacity and sales window.

colaborar.texto: The code is published under **MIT license**. You can install Eventarium on your own server, propose changes, or open an issue for anything you find missing.

catalogoEstilo.introduccion: Components live in "shared/ui" and are used by the application screens. Here they are, each with its states, so that a change in a token propagates without having to open file by file.

color.nota1: Samples follow the active theme: change it from the header toggle and you'll see the actual values for each.
color.nota2: "--faint" does not meet the minimum reading contrast, so it is excluded from text: it is only used for decorative lines. The accent appears at most twice per screen; the warning orange is reserved for the waitlist and alert states.

tipografia.bodyMuestra: Body text: DM Sans in base size with comfortable line spacing.
tipografia.nota: The uppercase mono label with tracking is the system's only decorative gesture, and it performs a real function: it labels sections and marks times, capacities, amounts, and codes.

botones.muestra: Component samples, not actions on this page
botones.nota: Minimum height of 44px to serve as a touch target. A single primary action per screen uses the primary style; the rest are secondary or text buttons.

estados.nota: Hover shifts the background in the luminosity channel; it never lightens the text: contrast after a state change does not drop below its resting state. Disabled is the only state with reduced contrast. Everything focusable has a focus ring.

chips.nota: Each state is read by its text as well as its color: even without color, the chip still says what it is.

campos.correoErrorMensaje: Enter a valid email so we can send you your ticket.
campos.textoLargoPlaceholder: Tell us about it and we'll prepare it

select.motivo: What brings you to the event?
select.nota: Replaces the browser dropdown, which doesn't support system typography or color. It is a progressive enhancement of a real select: the native one remains in the markup and saves the value, so the form works the same way and, if the script fails to load, the browser control appears instead.
select.notaTeclado: Full keyboard support: up and down arrows navigate, Home and End jump to the extremes, a letter searches for the option starting with it, Enter selects, Esc closes and returns focus to the button. If there is no space below, the dashboard expands upwards.

datos.railDescripcion: The bar lives inside a bordered rail: it is read by length, not just by color.
datos.nota: No chart is drawn if its proportion does not come from real data. When figures are not comparable, a numerical indicator is used instead of a comparative chart.

tablas.caption: Registration example
tablas.nota: Headers in monospace font, figures aligned so numerical columns line up, and row highlight on hover.

patronesPanel.uso: Headers, KPIs, panels, toolbars, and dialogs for administration screens
patronesPanel.kpiWarnDescriptor: The tone warns; the label informs
patronesPanel.toolbarNota: The toolbar lives in the panel header: search on the left, filters on the right.
patronesPanel.dialogoCuerpo: The body accepts any content; the optional footer places actions on the right. Escape and clicking the background will close it.

fondo.retriculaEtiqueta: Enlarged view of the background grid: 30-pixel cells with a 1-pixel line, with enhanced contrast for visibility
fondo.retriculaNota: Shown with enhanced contrast; the actual one is much fainter: see it in the background of this page. 30×30 px cell and 1px line. It lives on a fixed layer behind the content and fades out before the halfway point of the window height: it's paper texture, not a drawn grid.
fondo.marcaTexto: This block groups two example data points, and the key data point features

temas.oscuroDescripcion: Near-black background, light ink, and green as the action color. This is a literal reading of the reference.
temas.claroDescripcion: Uses the paper mode luminosities from the reference, with chroma at zero: cream is discarded.
temas.acentoDescripcion: Green becomes too light on paper. The tone is kept, and luminosity is lowered until the primary button is legible again.
temas.nota: The theme is applied before the first paint, so there is no flash when reloading, and it is remembered between screens.

cookies.uso: The banner and its categories, as used on the public website
cookies.notaBanner: Anchored bar at the bottom, never a modal wall: the page remains readable while it is open.
cookies.bannerTitulo: We use necessary cookies for registration to work.
cookies.bannerTexto: Measurement and communication cookies are only activated if you say so.
cookies.medicionHint: How many people start the form and how many finish it.
cookies.notaInterruptor: Rejecting costs exactly the same as accepting: same style, same size, at the same height. The status is read by position and text, not just by color.
